article.title: 企業如何防止AI代理「做錯事」，專家建議四大治理方向
article.summary:
過去一年，「代理式AI」（Agentic AI）成了科技圈熱門關鍵字。從協助寫程式的自動化助手，到能自主處理郵件、管理檔案，甚至代為執行系統指令的智慧代理，這些工具正快速走進企業日常運作，成為員工桌面與伺服器環境中的新住戶。
當企業急著擁抱效率紅利，新的資安破口也隨之浮現。這些擁有自主行動能力的AI代理究竟握有多少權限？IT與資安部門是否知道員工的電腦裡裝了什麼？一旦AI代理判斷失準、代為執行了不該執行的動作，企業又該如何應對？

article.title: Deals: Big discounts hit flagship phones from Samsung, Apple and Google
article.summary: While Amazon’s Prime Big Deal Days have wrapped up, discounts are still available on several smartphones. In fact, some devices that received few or no notable discounts during the sale are now available at reduced prices. Samsung’s Galaxy S26 Ultra, Apple’s iPhone 17 Pro lineup, and the entire Google Pixel 11 series are among the phones on sale this weekend. The latest Samsung Galaxy Z foldables have also been discounted. The Galaxy S26 Ultra and the Galaxy S26+ are both available with good discounts. article.title: Nvidia Explores Deal Options With Reflection AI, Financial Times Says
article.summary: Nvidia Corp. is in talks to boost its investment in Reflection AI or offer the startup computing power, a move that would strengthen ties with a key developer of open-weight models, according to a person familiar with the matter.
